name: Introduction to Hydrodynamic Stability
description: Overview of methods of stability analysis (linear and nonlinear theories), normal mode analysis. Examples of classical instabilities: Rayleigh-Taylor instability, Rayleigh-Bénard instability, Rayleigh-plateau instability, and instabilities in Taylor–Couette flow. Instabilities in parallel flows: temporal instability, Orr-Sommerfeld equation and Squire’s transformation; numerical technique for solving the Orr-Sommerfeld equation; spatio-temporal instability: evolution of perturbations in space-time, absolute and convective instabilities. Stability of non-parallel flows: instabilities in weakly nonparallel flows; nonlinear stability theory: weak nonlinearity, Landau equation, nature of bifurcation - supercritical and subcritical; interaction of linear modes, energy methods; transition to turbulence: transient growth, pseudo spectra and nonmodal instabilities.
